'''2001 Ontario Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship held in Ontario, Canada in 2001.<ref name="dt-16152">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16152 Ball's Bring Him Before Me], DeckTech (Spencer "s_ skywalker" Ball, 23 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16152/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16152/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Ontario, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from a player's DeckTech post, which dates it 12 May 2001. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

| Undefeated || [[Spencer Ball]]<ref name="dt-16152" /> || [[2001 Ontario Provincial Championship Spencer Ball Ball's Bring Him Before Me|Bring Him Before Me]] || —

Ball took his Dark deck to the Ontario Provincials on 12 May 2001, where it went undefeated; a week later, on 20 May, he won a tournament in Hamilton with it.<ref name="dt-16152" />
